decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is an application-layer service far from the firm's core network knowledge and faces strong collaboration platform competitors, so the firm has limited capacity to learn from and improve it, though it is not yet clearly abandoned.
Metro data centre connectivity builds directly on the firm's fibre and network expertise and already shows concrete adoption, so it fits its absorptive capacity well.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's core optical network know-how and gets a dedicated page, signalling strategic commitment and strong ability to refine it.

The number ordering portal supports the firm's established voice wholesale business and relies on familiar processes, so it is easy to interpret and improve, though it could be folded into a wider portal.

Carrier pre-selection rests on existing voice knowledge but serves a regulated legacy market in structural decline, which makes withdrawal fairly plausible, though short-term retention for existing customers is likely.
Direct voice network connection is close to the firm's core voice and network capabilities and supports enterprise and carrier customers, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and develop it.
